project.name: KashMap
project.domain: Privacy-first personal finance / net-worth tracker for Indian users
project.tenancy: single-user-per-account — Supabase RLS scoped by user_id (auth.uid()), NOT multi-tenant/org-based
actors: end user (owns all their own rows)
solo developer/operator (edits tierConfig.ts directly, no admin UI)
project.monetization: freemium — free tier, 30-day trial, one-time lifetime unlock. PAID_TIER_ENABLED is currently false (packages/shared/src/config/tierConfig.ts) — app runs 100% free for everyone until Razorpay is wired live.
project.origin: live, solo-developer-run product — not a from-scratch build

stack.shared: packages/shared — Zod schemas, Supabase query functions, pure business logic; wildcard subpath exports (./queries/*, ./logic/*)
stack.database: Supabase PostgreSQL, RLS per-user (not self-hosted, not org-scoped)
stack.payments: Razorpay — create-order (user session) + webhook (service_role) both funnel through apps/web/src/lib/applyPaymentCapture.ts so a payment is never applied twice
stack.pdf_export: jsPDF + jspdf-autotable, table-driven — never a DOM screenshot (RULES.md §4)
stack.hosting: Vercel (web) — see root README.md for mobile distribution

list: add-feature — standard workflow for adding any new feature, web or mobile
add-asset-class — add a new tracked asset type (14th+ asset class)
fix-import-bug — diagnose/fix a bank/broker CSV import failure or misparse
plan-large-feature — when/how to use Plan Mode for anything touching >3 files or a new table
review-before-merge — pre-merge checklist: verification, RLS, entitlement gating, secrets
skillsAlreadyDefined.note: Use these instead of re-deriving a workflow. vibe-starter/prompts/*.md are short pointers to them, not replacements.

perFeature: new table has RLS policy (user_id = auth.uid()) and a migration under supabase/migrations
new input validated with a Zod schema in packages/shared/src/schemas
Pro-gated feature checked via FEATURE_GATES in tierConfig.ts, enforced server-side
pnpm --filter web verify:rls passes if RLS changed

never: query a user's table without a user_id/auth.uid() filter — see RULES.md §1
use the service_role key outside a webhook/admin server context — see RULES.md §2
hardcode a price, limit, or feature gate outside tierConfig.ts — see root CLAUDE.md
commit directly without running pnpm typecheck first
always: cite a RULES.md section number (§1–§19) when a rule is in tension with a request
check MOBILE_ROADMAP.md before assuming a feature is 'web-only' or 'missing on mobile' — most parity gaps are already closed
update .agents/_session.md at the end of a work session
